citation.title: Age-Related Sex Differences in Glucose Tolerance by 75 g Oral Glucose Tolerance Test in Japanese

population.description: Young Japanese men of Table 1 (n = 505; 'aged 22-29 years' for the young group, Results; mean and SD of age and BMI from Table 1; the 22-29 range is the group definition, not printed as observed, so min and max are null). Recruitment setting is not described. No OGTT screening was applied: Table 2 classes 414 NGT, 77 high-normal FPG, 2 IFG, 10 IGT, 1 CGI, 1 diabetes; 'No participants were diagnosed with T2DM in the past or received antidiabetic medication'. So status is unselected. The young women (n = 280, Table 1, 264 NGT, 11 high-normal FPG, 5 IGT) are a protocol-level override; the middle-aged groups are not entered.

protocols.name: ogtt_ym
protocols.description: 75 g oral glucose load after a 12 h fast ('We performed 75 g OGTT after 12 h fast'), young males; plasma glucose and insulin at 0, 30, 60 and 120 min. Clock hour not stated.

protocols.name: fasted_ym
protocols.description: Short fasted arm for the printed preload (fasting) values of young males, drawn after the 12 h fast of the OGTT; no food. Clock hour and arm length not stated.
